description: Read the scene's draft (or a published version, with version): a resource (with its revision and children, the sub-paths to read next), a type such as element/Text or source/data (its props), a mask ending in /* (a list), or "" (the types). as: "image" on a frame or layer → a picture of it. (In a scene's draft; scene: its id.) Answers summary and value (the resource, with its revision and children), or image for as "image"; plus draftRevision (version, for a published version).

as.description: image: a picture of a frame (the whole of it, at most 1280 px wide) or of one layer (at full design size, to look closely; origin: where its top-left is in the frame), with what drew and the issues: text outside title-safe (5 % in from each edge: x 96–1824, y 54–1026 at 1920×1080), text too small, a bound table with no rows. json: a frame as JSON (its layers as a node tree) instead of code

at.description: Picture: ms since the frame went on air (default: entrances settled)

data.description: Picture: bindings read live values (the default: tables as last read) or sample data (each table's own rows). Either way state.* is the state the show starts with — what onStart sets, else each field's default or 0 / "" / false — and controls are their defaults: to see another state, set a field's default or what onStart returns

limit.description: Reading a table's rows (source/data/<id>/rows): how many to return; 20 when omitted

offset.description: Reading a table's rows (source/data/<id>/rows): the 0-based index of the first one; 0 when omitted

overlay.description: Picture: a guide drawn over it to check placement — grid: lines every 10 % labelled in design pixels; ids: each layer's outline and id. Omitted: none

path.description: type[/kind]/id[/…], a type, a mask ending in /*, or "" for the types

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

version.description: Read a saved published version instead of the draft: its number, or "published" for the latest one — published even when no stream is running. What a running stream shows: get_scene_state

name: scene_get

draftRevision.description: The draft as read: what publish_scene takes

image.description: as "image": the picture's size, scale, what drew and the issues

value.description: The resource as read, with its revision and children

version.description: The published version read, when one was asked for

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Read a scene's draft
